text: Bitcoin is holding steady around $64k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 1.2% advance, suggesting modest risk appetite returning to altcoins. The Fear & Greed index remains deeply in fear territory at 26 and has deteriorated over the past week, indicating lingering skepticism despite the small positive price movements. Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% with only $38B in daily volume points to cautious, measured trading rather than conviction buying.
